# `r cv_section_icon("chalkboard")` Teaching

## Invited Lectures

```{r teaching}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

invited <- tribble(
  ~ Title, ~Class, ~ Year, ~ Where,
  "Species Interaction Networks: A Macro-level Overview","Community Ecology", "2025 - Present", "Univerity of South Florida"
)

cv_entries(invited , with = "Title", when = "Year",
           what = "Class", where = "Where")

```

\vspace{\baselineskip}
## Teaching Materials

```{r materials}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

# link: https://reprodetox.netlify.app

materials <- tribble(
  ~ Title, ~Content, ~ Year, ~ Where,
  "(un)Reproducibility Detox - Package and Dependency Management","G. Higino, \\textbf{T. Strydom}", "Nov., 2021", "BIOS$^2$"
)

cv_entries(materials , with = "Title", when = "Year",
           what = "Content", where = "Where")

```
